flow.yaml.text:
id: note
name: note
input:
  lessons: !FileMemory
nodes:
  add:
    kind: tool
    tool_id: {lessons: append}
    input:
      path: notes.md
      text: Check sums twice.
output: ${add.output.path}

tools.description: List the memory's files, each with its hash and its size in characters. Pass dir to list one folder.
tools.name: list

dir.description: A folder of the memory to list; the whole memory when omitted.

tools.description: Read a file of the memory: its text, from line offset for limit lines, and the file's hash, which delete and rewrite take as if_hash.
tools.name: read

limit.description: The most lines to read; the rest of the file when omitted.

offset.description: The first line to read, counting from one; one when omitted.

path.description: A file's path in the memory, such as `notes/tools.md`: folders and a file name made of letters, digits, `.`, `_` and `-`, each starting with a letter or digit.

tools.description: Find the lines that hold query, ignoring case, in every file of the memory. Each match gives its path, line number and text, and the file's hash.
tools.name: search

tools.description: Add text to the end of a file, on a new line. Creates the file and its folders when missing, and never conflicts.
tools.name: append

path.description: A file's path in the memory, such as `notes/tools.md`: folders and a file name made of letters, digits, `.`, `_` and `-`, each starting with a letter or digit.

tools.description: Create a file holding text, and its folders when missing. Conflicts when the file exists.
tools.name: create

path.description: A file's path in the memory, such as `notes/tools.md`: folders and a file name made of letters, digits, `.`, `_` and `-`, each starting with a letter or digit.

tools.description: Replace the text old with new in a file. Conflicts unless old appears in the file exactly once; read the file first.
tools.name: edit

new.description: The text to put in its place.

old.description: The exact text to replace, as the file holds it.

path.description: A file's path in the memory, such as `notes/tools.md`: folders and a file name made of letters, digits, `.`, `_` and `-`, each starting with a letter or digit.

tools.description: Delete a file. Conflicts unless the file's hash is if_hash, as read gives it.
tools.name: delete

if_hash.description: The file's hash, as read gave it.

path.description: A file's path in the memory, such as `notes/tools.md`: folders and a file name made of letters, digits, `.`, `_` and `-`, each starting with a letter or digit.

tools.description: Replace the whole text of a file. Conflicts unless the file's hash is if_hash, as read gives it.
tools.name: rewrite
